name: gateway stills — a synchronous engine, no GPU anywhere in the path
_why: OWNER DIRECTIVE 2026-09-01: stills route back to the Lovable gateway and the GPU leaves the still path, because the RunPod worker had never drawn a frame on the current endpoint and every film was dying at `still 1`. The gateway answers in ONE call — `start` carries the frame — so this scenario proves the worker takes it without polling. The failure it exists to catch is expensive: a worker that polled a synchronous engine would earn a 400 per shot, and a future `poll` that redrew instead of refusing would bill a second image per shot forever. `key: null` is the other half — a gateway still is bytes that were never stored, so in-house motion cannot animate one. This is a CLASSIC grade, which is what the directive's era actually shipped: gateway stills under ONIQ's own Ken Burns, with Veo reserved for movie grade. Ten shots rather than three because the duration pre-gate refuses a film whose measured narration is under 50% of the sellable 60s minimum — the older three-shot scenarios predate that gate and now die before the still stage they were written to exercise.

job.prompt: a brave mouse in a bakery

plan.title: The Mouse Under the Bakery
plan.setting: a warm old bakery at night, flour dust in the lamplight

shots.still: A small brown mouse peers out from under a wooden floorboard of a dark bakery.
shots.narration: Under the floorboards of an old bakery there lived a very small and a very brave little brown mouse.

shots.still: Wide view of the dark bakery at night, moonlight lying flat across the flour-dusted counters.
shots.narration: Every night when the baker went home and locked the door, she came out to see what the world had left.

shots.still: The mouse carries a crumb twice its own size across the wide wooden floor.
shots.narration: And every night she carried home one crumb, which to a mouse is a very great treasure indeed to keep.

shots.still: A tall shelf of copper bowls above, seen from the mouse's low vantage on the floor.
shots.narration: But this night the shelf above her held a bowl of something warmer and sweeter than any crumb she knew.

shots.still: The mouse begins to climb a knotted apron string hanging from a hook on the wall.
shots.narration: So she took hold of the apron string that hung there and she began to climb, paw over careful paw.

shots.still: Halfway up the string, the mouse pauses as the string sways over the dark drop below.
shots.narration: Halfway up, the string swung out over the dark, and she held very still until the swinging stopped again.

shots.still: The mouse reaches the shelf edge beside a wide bowl of soft rising dough.
shots.narration: At the top she found the bowl, and in the bowl a soft pale hill of dough, rising slowly in the cold.

shots.still: A single lamp flickers on downstairs; long shadows stretch across the bakery floor below.
shots.narration: Then a lamp came on below her, and the shadows on the floor grew long and thin and reached for the wall.

shots.still: The mouse pinches off one small piece of dough and holds it against her chest.
shots.narration: She took one small piece, no larger than her own two paws, and she held it close against her chest.

shots.still: The mouse slips back beneath the floorboard, the small pale piece of dough held safe.
shots.narration: And down she went, under the boards, home again, with the finest treasure that bakery had ever given away.
